title: Lab/Pilot Scale Equipment
html:
Lab/Pilot Scale Equipment

Many of our customers have needs beyond the capabilities of standard benchtop systems.  These include but are not limited to:

  • Larger volume of samples needed for production testing
  • Automatic operation and sequencing
  • Advanced data collection and process monitoring
  • Multiple fraction separation

Accudyne will design and build laboratory or pilot scale equipment to our customer’s requirements.  Accudyne’s experience and the fact that all mechanical, chemical, and controls engineering is done in house leads to a system that is fully integrated– and flexible enough for piloting and process development work.

Machines are in use all over the world in applications ranging from botanical extraction to aerogel drying to waste remediation to biofuels development to nutraceuticals.
